clues: This city is the capital and largest city of Queensland in Australia. It sits by a wide bay, not far from the Pacific sea.
A warm sea flow near this city keeps its heat swings small. Its summers are long, hot, and wet for most of the warm half of the year.
This place began in 1824 as a jail camp for men sent far from Sydney. In 1825, the camp moved to a new spot on the river.
In 2032, this city will host the Summer Olympic Games and the Paralympic Games. That world meet is still years away from now.
South Bank and its wide parklands draw huge crowds each year. This green strip is a famed sight of the city.
